question: ΔPQR is right angled at Q. If PQ = 12 cm PR = 13 cm, find tan P + cot R.
solution:
**Given:**

ΔPQR is right angled at Q.

∠Q = 90°

PQ = 12 cm, PR = 13 cm

**Concept used:**

By Pythagoras theorem

⇒ H² = P² + B²

Tan θ = P/B, cot θ = B/P

Where H = hypotenuse ; P = perpendicular ; B = base

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67527901b739901080f2742aa11740cdee60c06bd30cad5cd4e897dc8f207d44.png] 

By Pythagoras theorem

⇒ H2 = P2 + B2

⇒ (13)² = (12)² + B²

⇒ B² = (169 - 144)

⇒ B = √25 = 5

Tan P = QR/PQ = 5/12

Cot R = QR/PQ =5/12

Tan P + cot R 

⇒ (5/12) + (5/12)

⇒ 10/12

**∴ The correct answer is 10/12.**
